part.text:
Fixed the javac `@SuperBuilder` handler to recognize top-level annotated type arguments (e.g. `Parent<@ValidDouble Double>`) when building the superclass builder's extends clause. Previously these were skipped, producing `ParentBuilder<C, B>` instead of `ParentBuilder<Double, C, B>`.

Validated with `ant test.instance`: 412 tests run, 0 failures.
